description: ELVIS (Elevation and Depth - Foundation Spatial Data) is a data repository run by Intergovernmental Committee on Surveying and Mapping (ICSM), with Geoscience Australia and state and territory agencies. ELVIS is a cloud map service through which users select an area and obtain Australian elevation and bathymetry data, including LiDAR point clouds and digital elevation models contributed by Commonwealth, state and territory governments. Coverage: Australia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as las, geotiff, xyz; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Elvis") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support flood and inundation modelling for Australian infrastructure. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
